description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy (%) for four different video understanding models, as presented in the paper “VideoLLaMB: Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory Bridges.” The x-axis, labeled “Number of Frames,” spans from 5 to 65 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 39 to 55, also on a linear scale, with major ticks every 1 unit. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Ours (Dynamic Seg)” (blue line with circular markers) starts at approximately 53.0% at 5 frames, rises slightly to 54.0% at 15 frames, and remains stable near 54.0% through 65 frames. “Ours (Static 4-Seg)” (green line with circular markers) begins at 52.5% at 5 frames, increases to 53.8% at 15 frames, and plateaus near 54.0% thereafter. “PLLaVA (DP 8)” (orange line with square markers) starts at 45.5% at 5 frames, drops to 43.0% at 15 frames, continues declining to 41.0% at 30 frames, and reaches 39.5% at 65 frames. “PLLaVA (DP 16)” (red line with square markers) begins at 45.8% at 5 frames, decreases to 45.0% at 15 frames, further declines to 44.0% at 30 frames, and ends at 42.0% at 65 frames. All lines are connected with solid lines and include markers at each data point.
